notes.title: [Patch] Early Access 1.22 version
notes.content:
[h2]New Buildings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/2526a22dab7a7ff7fbe3f8298a4e790411120071.png[/img]
The building "Apartments" has been added. 
It provides housing for 100 people and is larger than other houses.
In addition, the texture of the wide road has been changed.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrading buildings is always cheaper than constructing new buildings.
[*] The AI ​​of warehouse worker has been improved. Only the minimum workers needed to carry the items go to collect the items.
[/list]

[h2]UI & UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] A minor tutorial texts have been edited.
[*] More resolutions are supported. (3840x2160, 2560x1600, 2560x1440, 1920x1200, 1536x864)
[/list]

notes.title: [Patch] Early Access 1.20, 1.21 version
notes.content:
[h2]New Buildings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/c5a7f521af6cebb6fe2e454a556b81d9fa9271b7.png[/img]
The [b]university[/b] has been added.
Citizens who have just become adults can receive education.
They take classes for half the day and go to work for the rest of the day.
The education period is short, but it is as efficient as the school.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/7a90cfac36855df240043ef274471d391aeb4381.png[/img]
The [b]fishing dock[/b] and [b]bridge[/b] have been added.
Fishing dock can be built near water and produce fish.
People can get food in winter!
Building the bridge will allow people to cross the river quickly.

[h2]Terrain[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/af5252a4da63333c13067411cc9a7fc02687a819.png[/img]
Large and small rivers are added.
Depending on the map, there may be many or fewer rivers.
In addition, the map size has expanded by 33%.
As the map expands, more minerals will appear.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] The longer people starve, the faster hp decreases.
[*] The pathfinding algorithm has been enhanced.
[*] The recipe of fish stew has changed (fish 3 -> fish stew 5)
[*] More tools are provided at the start.
[/list]

[h2]UI & UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] The texts of new buildings are displayed while using the overlay mode.
[*] Can set edge mouse scrolling.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an error occurred when demolishing a building in overlay mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera zoomed when the cursor was outside the window.
[/list]

[h2]Hotfix 1.21[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where job priorities were not being set.
[*] The tool distribution rate is displayed except for those who don't have a job.
[/list]

notes.title: [Patch] Early Access 1.15, 1.16 version
notes.content:
We will prepare a roadmap in the near future!

[h2]Languages[/h2]
[list]
[*] French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese have been supported.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] People demand 25% less food.
[*] Tax revenues decrease by 25%.
[*] Tool durability is reduced 7% faster.
[*] If the citizen does not have the tool, the efficiency is reduced to 20%.
[*] Before nightfall, children and old people go home first.
The lag has been reduced because citizens return home sequentially.
[*] The upkeep of the police station has increased by 5%.
[*] The recipe of fabric has changed (cotton 1 -> fabric 1)
[*] The recipe of chemicals has changed (3 fruits -> 4 chemicals)
[*] As the value of fabric and chemicals increased, the prices of clothes and medicine also increased.
[*] The prices of stone houses and townhome have risen slightly.
[*] The storage limit of warehouse has increased by 25%.
[*] Small random events will occur.
They have the effects of changing happiness or resource's price.
[/list]

[h2]UI & UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can set any of the keyboard shortcuts.
[*] The overlay maps allow you to see production, the number of workers and residents, and happiness on the game map.
You can check the state of buildings by clicking the buttons at the bottom of the screen.
[*] The camera zoom-out range is extended so that you can see more widely.
[/list]

[h2]hotfix 1.16[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where research was not completed at 99% when the factory was demolished.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10 are available now!
notes.content:
Everything has been changed.
You can play in a completely new way.

[h2]New Resources[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/a5212983ebcc1a3dd21b37bc97934d9ce9ae8357.png[/img]
Some resources have been removed and new resources have been added. added. To meet the needs of citizens, a larger amount is demanded. But, with the strengthen production chains, players can focus more on resource management.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/529d826f8fc7047811b8dc39df82cb38e7b15d6b.png[/img]
In addition, you can increase the productivity with windmills and offices that increase the efficiency of nearby buildings.

[h2]Trade[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/1ca22b233c9d445268dd6f05406666ebbdfadf35.png[/img]
You can trade resources. There is a fee, but the trading makes you manage the city's resources flexibly. And [b]money[/b], an important resource, has been added. The various resources in the previous version were integrated and became money, which is spent on many places, including research and trading, city maintenance, and payment of wage.

[h2]UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/db928d4ee4a0f057f627e891c06623655742df3e.png[/img]
Many convenience features have been added, such as prioritizing job, fixing the number of employees, displaying detailed inventory and information about workers and residents.

[h2]City Management[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/b1d60325919a0b9fb793d6c6f8fcf58523e7c37e.png[/img]
You may not have felt like a mayor before, but now you can intervene in many parts of the city. In particular, you can set food provision, tax rate to increase the happiness and control immigration for population growth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/3af4caf4abf27687b5526fefd094671222bd03bd.png[/img]
The [b]Happiness[/b] is no longer a resource 'consumed' to increase the population. The higher the happiness, the better for the city. It does not decrease due to a larger population. Check the happiness at any time to see how well you are doing your job.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38526457/add43d1d8c7ab75f3b9eb3f917586235c45ba1dc.png[/img]
A friendly tutorial has been provided.
Completing the tutorial ensures that you understand the basic concepts of the game.

[h2]Hotfix 1.11 ~ 1.13[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the warehousemen did not go to take out items 
when the building was far away
[*]Fixed an issue where resources were not being collected on harsh difficulty.
[*]Fixed UI display issues.
[*] The offices improve efficiency by 35%.
[*] The behavior of people has become smarter. They will find the shortest way better.
[/list]
